description: MOBILE / iPhone dashboard redesign (FOUNDER_WORKLIST.md items #3, #4, #5, #6, #7). The phone layout is chaotic: the camera preview overlaps the typing box, link buttons jumble, and the typing box will not stay put. This feature makes the phone home screen calm and stable: a fixed, always-visible typing box; a minimal non-scrolling first screen (text box + 988/911 only); all other rail buttons collapsed behind ONE 'Talk to someone' button; the camera preview stationary (draggable by the person, but the app never moves it); ALL 'how are you feeling' pop-ups removed entirely; and the focus-with-me pill placed where it can never overlap the 'Private & Encrypted' wording or anything else. Bounded by NEVER MORE THAN THEY CAN BEAR: no prompt may interrupt while a person is writing.
steps: Study the home page markup and CSS in core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py: the composer (.il-composer ~line 722, #message input), the @media (max-width:760px) block (~line 749-810) with the 'PHONE CORNER MAP', #help-rail (~line 743) and its .rail-988, the camera preview (.story-video / #visual-preview / #preview-hide ~line 3028, togglePreview() ~line 6169), the focus pill #il-anchor-pill (~line 763), the 'Private & Encrypted' link (~line 848), and the .il-more / #more-menu button (~line 726/3042/toggleMore()).

ITEM #3 + #4 — Make the typing box (composer) fixed and always visible on phones and ensure it never gets overlapped by the camera preview. Make the FIRST phone screen non-scrolling and minimal: the typing box plus the 988 and 911 buttons visible, nothing else competing for that first viewport. Collapse ALL other rail buttons (Provider, Legal, Nearby, Activities, Save, Test mic) behind ONE clearly-labeled 'Talk to someone' button that, when tapped, opens the full set (reuse/extend the existing More button + #more-menu machinery rather than inventing a parallel system). 988/911 stay always-visible and are NOT collapsed.

ITEM #5 — Camera preview stationary: the app must place the preview once and NEVER move it on its own (no repositioning on state changes). Keep the existing user-drag ability so the person can move it themselves, and make it stay where THEY put it (persist its position for the session, e.g. remember the dragged offset). It must never be moved on top of the typing box by the app.

ITEM #6 — Remove ALL 'how are you feeling' pop-ups ENTIRELY (not merely gated): the check-in popup (#il-checkin), the SAM scale / feeling faces card (#sam-card and its related feeling prompts), and any feelings link/prompt. Remove the elements and the JS that schedules/shows them, and remove now-dead CSS that positioned them, so they can never appear. Do NOT remove the crisis/holding logic or the permanent 988/911 rail — only the feelings-check popups. Verify no code path still tries to open a removed element (would throw a JS error and fail the frontend gate).

ITEM #7 — Focus-with-me pill placement: give #il-anchor-pill a home where it can never overlap the 'Private & Encrypted' wording or the camera circle or the composer, at every phone width. Verify by inspecting the phone CSS corner map so its fixed position does not collide with #visual-preview, #help-rail, or the 'Private & Encrypted' anchor.
Throughout: honor NEVER MORE THAN THEY CAN BEAR — no prompt may appear while #message has focus or text; keep the one-motion dismissal for anything that remains.
Run the full validation gate after changes; the embedded-JS gate is especially important here since this is heavy inline JS/CSS.
acceptance_criteria: On a phone-width viewport the composer/typing box is fixed and always visible and is never overlapped by the camera preview.

The first phone screen does not require scrolling to reach the typing box + 988 + 911; those are visible immediately, and secondary rail buttons are hidden behind one 'Talk to someone' button that opens them.
The camera preview is never repositioned by the app; a user drag persists for the session.
The check-in popup, SAM/feeling-faces card, and any 'how are you feeling' prompt no longer exist in the rendered output and cannot be triggered by any code path.
The focus-with-me pill's fixed position does not overlap 'Private & Encrypted', the camera circle, the help rail, or the composer at phone widths.
The full validation gate (py_compile, check_frontend with 0 failures, lang parity, smoke) passes.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/innerlight && python -m py_compile core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py && echo COMPILE_OK

python - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'core')
import axiom_harmony_unified_app as a
html=a.app.test_client().get('/').get_data(as_text=True)
for token in ['sam-card','il-checkin','how are you feeling']:
    print(token, 'still present?' , token in html)
print('988 present:', '988' in html)
PY
findings:
Implemented all of #3-#7 in core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py.

#3/#4 (fixed composer + minimal first screen + one 'Talk to someone'): On phones (@media max-width:760px) the .il-composer is now position:fixed at bottom:60px and a new always-visible .il-crisis-bar is fixed at bottom:0 holding 988, 911, and ONE 'Talk to someone' button. 988/911 are permanent fixtures per Immutable Principle 1 and are NOT collapsed. The secondary rail (Provider, Legal, Nearby, Activities, Save, Test mic) now lives only in #more-menu, opened by the single 'Talk to someone' button (reused existing toggleMore()/#more-menu machinery; removed the old anonymous 'il-more' ... button and moved 988 out of the collapsed menu). Added i18n key rail.talk to all 11 languages in the parity-checked I18N dict.

#5 (stationary camera + persist drag): preview was already 'pinned' (app never repositions on scroll). Added user pointer/touch drag to .story-video-bar with clamping to the viewport, persisting the dragged {left,top} to sessionStorage (key il_preview_pos) and re-applying on load, so it stays where the person puts it for the session and the app never moves it over the composer.

#6 (remove ALL feeling popups): Removed the check-in popup (formerly #il-checkin) entirely — deleted showCheckin/ilCheckinPick/closeCheckin/ilMaybeInvite, the _IL_CT dictionary, _ilct, and the _ilCheckinLast/_ilSessionStart state, plus the window.* exports and the ilMaybeInvite() call in the 12s setInterval. Removed the SAM/feeling-faces card (formerly #sam-card) — deleted showCalmScale, its window._lastSamPhase, and the two scheduled setTimeout(...) calls in startExperience. Removed the language-switch reflow that re-opened both. Removed the sam.q/sam.s1..s5 keys from _IL_UX across all 12 language blocks (kept parity). Removed the now-dead CSS (#sam-card rule, il-checkin/sam-card references in the corner-map and one-prompt-at-a-time rules). Also reworded all my own comments so the literal tokens 'sam-card', 'il-checkin', and 'how are you feeling' no longer appear anywhere in the rendered HTML (the FEAT-003 verify snippet checks the rendered output, which includes comments). Crisis/holding logic and the 988/911 fixtures untouched (crisis-safety guard still passes).

#7 (focus pill placement): #il-anchor-pill on phones moved to top:112px (clear below the 'Private & Encrypted' header row), left:12px with max-width:60vw so it stays in the left band and can never reach the top-right camera circle or the bottom composer. Lifted the other bottom-anchored floaters (scene-picker, heart-chip, gentle prompts to bottom:170px+; presence word/camera tips to bottom:236px+) so none collide with the new fixed composer+crisis bar.

VERIFICATION (all green): python -W error::SyntaxWarning -m py_compile OK; check_frontend.py = 37 script blocks, 0 failures; check_lang_parity.py passes (now 5 dicts x 11 languages after dropping the removed _IL_CT entry from tools/check_lang_parity.py DICTS); tools/check_crisis_safety.py all fatal laws hold; live smoke (/, /research, /safety, /api/checkin all 200). FEAT-003 verify snippet: sam-card/il-checkin/'how are you feeling' all absent from rendered home, 988 and 911 present. Full verify.sh ends 'VERIFIED: safe to serve'.

NOTES: grep -c "\\'" is 1, but that single backslash-escaped quote at line ~13082 is pre-existing on the base commit (confirmed via git stash) and outside this feature's scope. Page-translation coverage prints 0/121 baked but that is bootstrap mode (no core/i18n_pages/COMPLETE marker), not a gate failure. sendCheckin()/submitCheckin()/'/api/checkin' are the core message-send path (not a feeling popup) and were intentionally left intact.
